top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Ottawa's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.

GFNY Ottawa's fast two-lap rolling course rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 73 miles.
When someone attacks on fast two-lap rolling course, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
GFNY Ottawa's fast two-lap rolling course rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
73 miles on fast two-lap rolling course burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At GFNY Ottawa, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Ottawa. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Ottawa. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on fast two-lap rolling course. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Ottawa's fast two-lap rolling course actually does to you.
Varied gradients on fast two-lap rolling course demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Ottawa's 73 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Ottawa rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on fast two-lap rolling course to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 73 miles of fast two-lap rolling course in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.
